intro: Slovenia is a parliamentary republic and a member of the EU, NATO and the eurozone.

chapters.title: Parliament and president
text: The National Assembly has 90 members, two of whom represent the Italian and Hungarian minorities. The president is directly elected; Nataša Pirc Musar became the first woman president in 2022.

chapters.title: Symbols
text: The flag is white, blue and red with a coat of arms showing Triglav and three stars.

keyTerms.meaning: A smaller group within a country, often with its own language or culture.
